applicabilityBasis.summary: tx announces a fully backed 1:1 USD settlement asset issued by Brale for tokenized markets.

genius.notes: USTX is announced as a Brale-issued native tx stablecoin. Brale’s general security page states FinCEN MSB registration and state licensing/exemptions, plus alignment with emerging GENIUS requirements. These statements do not establish a token-specific GENIUS issuer authorization or application. No affirmative or comprehensive negative authorization finding is claimed. Generic reserve reporting and end user terms are not a retrieved USTX-specific reserve report or complete holder redemption policy.
